answer: Each identity must send a pulse heartbeat from its own beacon once an hour, and the beacon registry logs every signal. When two identities pulse from one beacon, both lose their full reward of about 258,000 POA, and the operator pays a 350,000 POA fine per fake to honest peers. The fable of one operator behind many beacons ends at the first shared pulse, since the registry bars the operator's remaining identities from the next epoch. Five fakes therefore cost about 3,040,000 POA — 1,290,000 POA in lost rewards plus 1,750,000 POA in fines — before any reward clears.
